title: Layered Audio ownership and evidence doctrine
summary: Layered Audio owns acoustic material meaning, immutable source/derived lineage, view-specific assessments, boundaries, scene-time projections, processing provenance and the live Audio object relationships exposed to intention discovery. Interpretation, federation and execution providers do not become acoustic truth.
invariants: Source evidence is never mutated merely to make processing convenient.
A derived signal is new material with lineage; it does not replace its source.
Assessment agreement is corroboration, not accuracy.
Transcript, speaker, pitch, music, spatial and alignment views may disagree and retain independent boundaries and surety.
Audio owns which Audio objects, features and relationships exist now. Dynamic intention discovery observes that truth; it does not manufacture it.
Intention Service owns interpretation, clarification and READY gating, not Audio semantics.
Management Intention Discovery may federate Audio-owned surfaces and relationships, but does not copy the Audio object model or acquire Audio authority.
Storage paths, locations and materialisation leases remain Storage concerns; Audio retains durable Storage identity only through an explicit Audio-Storage binding.

provenance.claim: Historical/current Layered Audio architecture and qualification continuity baseline.
Additive object-bound intention and Management federation overlay; does not replace Audio evidence authority.
